result.summary: Implemented docs/agents/design/REQ-029.md exactly as designed -- QR check-in via a `ci_` /start deep link, plus the organizer-only `checkin:override:` callback. No schema change (design §0, independently re-confirmed: qr_token/checked_in_at/checked_in_by/check_in_method/registrations_qr_token_unique/chk_registrations_checked_in_only_if_admitted all pre-exist from REQ-011/020). 1. apps/bot/src/domain/event.ts: extended StartPayload with `{ kind: "checkin"; qrToken: string }` and parseStartPayload with a `ci_` prefix branch, checked before the existing `e_` branch (§1.1) -- no shape validation of the token, an empty/malformed token simply fails §2.1's lookup later (falls into the existing unknown-token refusal). 2. apps/bot/src/domain/eventStaffAuthorization.ts: buildCheckinRefusalAudit and requireEventStaffForEvent each gained one new, optional, TRAILING `registrationId?: string` parameter (§5.2) -- when omitted, `entity`/`entityId` stay exactly 'event'/eventId (byte-for-byte unchanged from today); when supplied (only REQ-029's own call site does), they become 'registration'/registrationId, satisfying AC1's 'names the registration' requirement. Verified backward-compatible by re-running REQ-018's (checkin.forgery.test.ts) and REQ-028's (checkin.db.test.ts) existing suites unchanged -- both still pass (11/11), confirming every existing call site (unchanged argument count) is unaffected. 3. apps/bot/src/domain/registration.ts: exported the previously-file-private deriveCheckinDisplayName (§2.1's own note, plumbing-only, zero behavior change). Added QrCheckinLookup + getRegistrationByQrTokenForCheckin(db, qrToken, lang) per §2.1 -- one unlocked SELECT joining registrations->events->chapters->profiles(LEFT)->users, keyed on qr_token, never selecting phone/email; added eventChapterTimezone to the returned shape beyond the design's own listed fields (a plumbing addition for AC2's checked-in-time rendering, formatDateTimeInTimezone needs a timezone and the design's own open question 3 leaves message-composition mechanics to BACKEND-DEV). Added getCheckinActorDisplayName(db, checkedInByUserId, lang) per §2.2. Added QrCheckinDecisionInput/QrCheckinOutcome/decideQrCheckinOutcome per §3.2 -- pure, first-match-wins, exact 4-step table (deliberately NOT decideCheckinToggleOutcome -- QR never undoes a check-in). Added performQrCheckIn(db, registrationId, qrToken, staffUserId, at) per §3.3 -- db.transaction, SELECT...FOR UPDATE (fresh, locked), the S4 token-currency recheck (the locked row's OWN qr_token must still equal the scanned token, else treated as 'unknown-token' even though the row exists -- closes the stale-reissued-token gap), decide, and on 'check-in' a conditional UPDATE (check_in_method='qr') + exactly one writeAuditLog call in the same transaction; 'refused-not-admitted'/'unknown-token' write nothing, 'already-checked-in' writes nothing (AC2's 'NEVER a duplicate write', proven in test below). Added OverrideDecisionInput/OverrideOutcome/decideOverrideOutcome per §4.1 -- deliberately no capacity check (S7's own logged-override principle). Added overrideAdmitAndCheckIn(db, registrationId, organizerUserId, at) per §4.2 -- one UPDATE (admission->admitted + check-in fields, check_in_method='manual') + exactly one writeAuditLog call ('registration.override_admit_checkin'), one transaction. Added getRegistrationDisplayInfo(db, registrationId, lang) -- a small, one-off plumbing read (design Open Question 4's own latitude) the override callback needs to compose its own success screen, keyed by registrationId since that flow never has a qr_token. 4. apps/bot/src/handlers/checkinQr.ts (NEW): resolveCheckinQrDeepLink(ctx, db, scannerUserId, lang, qrToken) per §6.1 -- looks up the token, authorizes via the extended requireEventStaffForEvent (supplying registrationId so a refusal's audit row names it), then performQrCheckIn using scannerUserId (passed straight through from the caller's own ctx.from.id-derived resolution -- Open Question 4 resolved by reusing the caller's resolution rather than a second, redundant resolveActingUser call) as the staffUserId, then replies per outcome (unknown-token / event-ended / notStaff / refused-not-admitted-with-override-button / already-checked-in-report / check-in-success). CHECKIN_OVERRIDE_PATTERN + makeCheckinOverrideCallbackHandler per §6.2 -- re-derives the registration's event/chapter, authorizes via requireOrganizerForChapter (REQ-016, reused unchanged, stricter than EventStaff per §4.3), then overrideAdmitAndCheckIn. 5. apps/bot/src/handlers/start.ts: makeStartHandler gained a second payload branch (`payload.kind === "checkin"`) alongside the existing `"event"` branch, dispatching to resolveCheckinQrDeepLink -- no consent gate (design §1.2's own stated reasoning: the flow writes nothing new about the SCANNER, only checked_in_by on someone else's registration, the same no-consent-on-the-actor precedent every existing staff/organizer action already sets). 6. apps/bot/src/i18n/{types.ts,en.ts,ru.ts}: added the `checkinQr` top-level catalog key (§7) -- unknownToken, eventEnded, notStaff, alreadyCheckedIn, refusedWaitlisted/Requested/Withdrawn/Rejected, overrideButtonLabel, overrideNotAuthorized, overrideNotApplicable, overrideSuccess, successHeader. Placeholder/provisional copy per decisions/0002 (CONTENT-BA owns final wording). successHeader/overrideSuccess interpolate {name}/{company}/{checkedIn} only (countCheckedIn's own live counter, reused as-is per design §11 -- NOT a checked-in/total ratio, since the design's §11 'reused unchanged' list names only countCheckedIn for these two screens, not countAdmittedRegistrations). 7. apps/bot/src/index.ts: registered `bot.callbackQuery(CHECKIN_OVERRIDE_PATTERN, makeCheckinOverrideCallbackHandler(db))`. No new command registered for the QR flow itself -- it rides the existing `bot.command("start", ...)` registration (AC7). All 7 ACs verified with real output against a live scratch Postgres (apps/bot/docker-compose.yml, port 55432, already running/migrated). New test file apps/bot/src/handlers/checkinQr.db.test.ts, 6 describe blocks (AC1-AC6, AC7 verified separately via git grep), real bot.handleUpdate() dispatch throughout (/start ci_ command updates + checkin:override callback_query updates), following checkin.db.test.ts's established fake-bot-api-capture pattern. AC1's audit-on-refusal is asserted as a positive existence check (exactly 1 'checkin.refused' row, entity='registration', entityId=registrationId, actorUserId=the non-staff scanner) -- not merely 'no error thrown'. AC2's repeat-scan proof compares the exact stored checkedInAt Date.getTime() before vs. after the second scan (byte-for-byte, not just 'still non-null'), and confirms the audit_log row count for action='registration.checkin' stays at exactly 1 after the repeat (zero additional writes). AC3's waitlisted/requested cases use a token-bearing non-admitted row -- since registerForEvent (REQ-020 §3.2 step 8) never issues a qr_token to a waitlisted/requested outcome, there is no public-API path producing one; the test flips admission on an already-admitted (token-bearing) row via direct SQL specifically to exercise decideQrCheckinOutcome/performQrCheckIn's own documented table, and this is called out inline in the test's own comment rather than presented as an unqualified real-world scenario. AC3's withdrawn case, by contrast, IS a genuine reachable state reached via the real withdrawRegistration domain function (which only ever touches the `admission` column, never qr_token). AC6 additionally verifies the negative case the design's §4.3 reasoning implies but no AC states outright: a plain EventStaff volunteer (not organizer) tapping their own refusal's override button is refused, with zero write and zero new audit_log row. Commands run from the REPO ROOT: `npm run lint` -> exit 0 (apps/bot 0 problems; apps/web 2 pre-existing unrelated -element warnings, untouched by this diff). `npm run build` -> exit 0 (apps/web Next.js build + apps/bot tsc, both clean). `npx vitest run --no-file-parallelism` (repo root, no path filter) -> 28 files / 286 tests passed, 0 failed, 0 skipped (up from the pre-existing 27 files / 277 tests -- +1 new test file, +9 new tests, zero regressions). `git grep -i "web_app\|webapp\|mini.?app" apps/bot/src` -> only pre-existing `has_main_web_app: false` grammY BotInfo fixture fields already present in 10 unrelated test files before this branch (verified via git log -- none of those lines are new); zero Mini App/WebApp/custom-scanning-client code anywhere (AC7 PASS). `git status --porcelain` before writing this handoff confirms exactly the 7 modified files plus the 2 new files listed in artifacts_out -- no stray file, apps/web and messages/** untouched.

AC1 (checkinQr.db.test.ts 'REQ-029 AC1'): a plain member (not EventStaff for the event) dispatches /start ci_<admitted-attendee's-real-qr-token> -> reply is catalog.checkinQr.notStaff -> exactly 1 audit_log row with action='checkin.refused', entity='registration', entityId=the scanned registration's id, actorUserId=the non-staff scanner's own user id (not null) -> the registration's checked_in_at confirmed still null

AC2 (checkinQr.db.test.ts 'REQ-029 AC2'): staff scans an admitted attendee's real token -> checked_in_at set (non-null), checked_in_by=staff's user id, check_in_method='qr', exactly 1 audit_log row action='registration.checkin' -> the SAME token scanned a second time -> checked_in_at.getTime() identical to the first scan's captured value (byte-for-byte), checked_in_by/check_in_method unchanged, audit_log action='registration.checkin' count still exactly 1 (zero new writes), and the reply text matches the exact catalog.checkinQr.alreadyCheckedIn interpolation (formatted check-in time in the chapter's Asia/Tashkent timezone + the checking staff member's @tgUsername)

AC3 (checkinQr.db.test.ts 'REQ-029 AC3', 2 tests): (a) a real admitted->withdrawn transition via withdrawRegistration (qr_token preserved, a genuinely reachable state) scanned by staff -> reply=catalog.checkinQr.refusedWithdrawn, an override button offered with callback_data=checkin:override:<registrationId>, checked_in_at stays null; (b) waitlisted and requested cases (token-bearing non-admitted rows, constructed to exercise decideQrCheckinOutcome's own table since no public path produces a token-bearing waitlisted/requested row) -> reply=catalog.checkinQr.refusedWaitlisted/refusedRequested respectively, checked_in_at stays null in both

AC4 (checkinQr.db.test.ts 'REQ-029 AC4', 2 tests): (a) /start ci_<random 32-hex-byte unknown token> -> reply=catalog.checkinQr.unknownToken; (b) a real admitted, token-bearing registration on an event whose ends_at is 2020-01-01 (in the past relative to the real evaluation clock) scanned by staff -> reply=catalog.checkinQr.eventEnded, checked_in_at stays null

AC5 (checkinQr.db.test.ts 'REQ-029 AC5'): an admitted attendee with a real phone (+77011234567) and email (attendee-secret@example.com) plus company='Acme Corp' on file -> successful scan's reply text contains 'Dana K', 'Acme Corp', and the live counter '1', but contains neither the raw phone nor the raw email string anywhere

AC6 (checkinQr.db.test.ts 'REQ-029 AC6', 2 tests): (a) organizer taps the override button on a withdrawn attendee's refusal -> registration.admission='admitted', checked_in_at non-null, checked_in_by=organizer's id, check_in_method='manual', exactly 1 audit_log row action='registration.override_admit_checkin' actorUserId=organizer's id, success reply contains the attendee's name+company; (b) the SAME scenario tapped by the plain EventStaff volunteer (not organizer) who received the refusal -> registration unchanged (still withdrawn, checked_in_at still null), zero override_admit_checkin audit rows, answerCallbackQuery alert text=catalog.checkinQr.overrideNotAuthorized

issues.title: design/REQ-029.md's QrCheckinLookup (§2.1) and successHeader/overrideSuccess catalog copy (§7) don't specify a chapter-timezone field or a {total} placeholder, but rendering AC2's checked-in time and composing the success screens needed both resolved one way or another
issues.description: Resolved additively, not as an invented business rule: (1) added `eventChapterTimezone` to QrCheckinLookup (an extra SELECT column, joining chapters -- the same join getEventByIdWithChapterTimezone already performs elsewhere) so AC2's already-checked-in report can format the timestamp via the existing formatDateTimeInTimezone mechanism (REQ-017 §2.1) instead of an unlocalized raw ISO string. (2) successHeader/overrideSuccess catalog copy interpolates only {name}/{company}/{checkedIn} (countCheckedIn's live counter, reused as-is per design §11's own 'reused unchanged' list, which names only countCheckedIn for these two screens) -- NOT a checked-in/total ratio, since no design section specifies countAdmittedRegistrations is also needed here and inventing a ratio would be adding an unrequested UI element. Both are plumbing/formatting choices within Open Question 3's explicit latitude ('no acceptance criterion pins the exact message-editing mechanic'), not schema or business-rule changes -- flagged per core-directives.md's 'never resolve a conflict silently' rule.
